name: iO-808
tagline: A silver 808 on the table. Tap the steps. Share a beat.
description:
Sixteen yellow buttons in a row, cream labels, orange knobs. Bass drum, snare, toms, hats, cowbell, clap — the usual kit. Tap a step to put a hit on it, twist a knob for tone or decay, press Start, and the lights walk.

Your patterns stay on this device, inside the app. Close it, come back, the beat is where you left it.

Press Share a pattern, then Invite (in the GifOS menu), and send the link. The friend who opens it gets the same beat — same steps, same knobs, same tempo.

An unofficial port of io-808 by Vincent Riemer. Bugs go to GifOS, not upstream.
